title: rehan-remade/universal-modder
why_read: An ambitious and unusual use of Claude Code plus generative media tools to automatically mod PC games, interesting as an agent-use-case even if quality is unproven.
analysis: This project packages reverse-engineering skills, generative art/3D/audio tools (via fal's API), and in-game testing into a toolkit that lets Claude Code attempt to mod arbitrary PC games. It's a creative and fairly ambitious application of AI agents to a messy, unstructured domain (game binaries and assets) that typically requires significant manual reverse-engineering expertise. The real-world reliability of such automated modding is questionable, but it's a good example of pushing agentic coding tools into unconventional domains beyond typical software engineering tasks.
